WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26_q3, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25_q3,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q3 ty
JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region;

SELECT 'sales_dup' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_distinct, MIN(sale_date) AS d0, MAX(sale_date) AS d1
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_dup', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_dup', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), MIN(CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)), MAX(CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE))
FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL
SELECT 'q3_dates_' || fiscal_year, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_week), MIN(calendar_date), MAX(calendar_date)
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY fiscal_year;

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, d.c
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 12;

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, MIN(sale_date) AS d0, MAX(sale_date) AS d1,
         MIN(net_amount) AS n0, MAX(net_amount) AS n1, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS l0, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS l1
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', d0) AS m, COUNT(*) AS keys, SUM(c-1) AS extra_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ids=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n0=n1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_amount, MIN(l0) AS first_load, MAX(l1) AS last_load
FROM dups GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT o.status, s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MIN(f.sale_date) AS d0, MAX(f.sale_date) AS d1
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code = 'WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND r.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1;

WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), q3 AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT ty.region, ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_quarter, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ly.fiscal_year AS prior_fiscal_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS prior_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY CASE ty.region WHEN 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ty.region;
